title: Photogrammetry
description: The photogrammetry look reconstructs 3D geometry and texture from overlapping photographs, so a real place is turned into a scanned mesh. Slightly wrong normals, stretched texture, and holes are the evidence of capture.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: The camera can orbit a courtyard that was photographed, not built. Faces of stone look photographed because they were, then wrapped onto geometry.
Use it when the scene should feel surveyed: a real site captured as a model. It is the wrong tool for a handmade miniature, and it is not proof of a physics simulation.
A black-hole visualization is simulation-led imagery, a cousin name in the catalog, not a scan.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Shoot many overlapping stills around the subject, triangulate a mesh, project the photographs as texture. The look: texture stretching at grazing angles, missing undersides, a seam where coverage failed.
Light can be the captured light, or a new CG key on the mesh. The camera path is free because the space is geometry.
Prompt a photogrammetry look: scanned space, slightly wrong mesh, a real place turned into a model.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Experimental documentaries and game cutscenes orbit scanned spaces. Interstellar is listed beside them as simulation-led imagery (Gargantua's computed disk), a cousin of modeled pictures, not a photogrammetric mesh.
Use the scan look for places. Use simulation when the phenomenon was computed.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Photogrammetry look of [Subject], scanned space, slightly wrong mesh, a real place turned into a model. Name overlapping-photo texture, a hole or stretch, and an orbit or inspection camera.
Ban a toy diorama and ban a perfect game render.

Create a visualization concept for a spinning black hole with an accretion disk appearing lensed around the dark central region. Use a validated ray-traced simulation as the geometric reference and preserve its major contours. Label this as a cinematic visualization, not a newly computed scientific result.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousins are a Diorama and a clean engine render. The tell is painted miniature charm, or PBR plastic with no photo texture.
The fix is photographic skin on imperfect geometry, seams included.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is photogrammetry in film?
Photogrammetry reconstructs 3D geometry and texture from overlapping photographs. The look is a real place turned into a scanned mesh, often with slight error.
Photogrammetry vs diorama
A diorama is built at miniature scale. Photogrammetry starts from photographs of a real site and wraps them on computed geometry. One is a model you light. The other is a survey you inspect.
When should I use photogrammetry?
Use it when a location should read as captured and then modeled, inspectable, slightly wrong. Skip it for handmade miniatures or for computed phenomena that were never photographed.
How do I prompt photogrammetry for AI image or video?
Write Photogrammetry look of [Subject], scanned space, slightly wrong mesh. Demand photo texture, stretch or holes, and a camera that can orbit the model.
